Class AffiliationDatabase

    • createPirateCrew

      public PirateCrew createPirateCrew(String crewName, String shipName, Pirate captain)
      Purpose: Founds a new pirate crew under the given captain.
      Parameters:
      crewName - falls back to "Unnamed Crew" if null/blank
      shipName - falls back to "Unnamed Ship" if null/blank
      captain - the founding captain, who is enrolled automatically
      Returns:
      the newly founded crew
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the captain is null or already in a crew

    • createMarineCorps

      public MarineCorps createMarineCorps(String corpsName, String baseLocation, String corpsCommander, long operationalFunds)
      Purpose: Establishes a new marine corps unit.
      Parameters:
      corpsName - falls back to "Unnamed Corps" if null/blank
      baseLocation - falls back to "Unknown Base Location" if null/blank
      corpsCommander - falls back to "Unknown Commander" if null/blank
      operationalFunds - falls back to 0 if negative
      Returns:
      the newly established corps
